$about: Canonical customer-facing commerce copy manifest (krok 2B). English is the SOURCE of meaning; final translations for all 13 locales are produced by a human language reviewer from this file — never machine-translated, never English-copied. Storefront keys live in src/i18n/messages/<locale>.json; email.* keys live in the maky-apps SMTP repo (apps/smtp/src/modules/smtp/i18n/catalogs/<locale>.json).
$syntax: ICU MessageFormat: {name} placeholders; plurals as {count, plural, one {...} few {...} other {...}} (Slovak/Czech/Polish/Romanian need one+few+other; English one+other).
$legalNote: Keys flagged legallySensitive carry statutory wording (e.g. the order button 'Objednať s povinnosťou platby' = explicit payment-obligation order per EU consumer law) — translations must preserve the legal meaning for the target market.

checkout.payment.methodRequired.context: Error when the Stripe payment-method type cannot be resolved for transaction initialization.

checkout.payment.notFullyPaid.source: The payment does not yet cover the full order total. Refresh the page — if funds were authorized, use the “Place order” button. Do not pay again until the status is confirmed.
checkout.payment.notFullyPaid.context: Mapped from a Saleor checkoutComplete CHECKOUT_NOT_FULLY_PAID error on the payment step; the quoted button label must stay in sync with the legally mandated pay CTA (checkout.placeOrder).

checkout.payment.orContinueBelow.context: Divider label under the decorative wallet buttons pointing to the regular checkout form (rendered uppercase via CSS).

checkout.payment.orPayWithCard.context: Divider label under the Stripe wallet buttons (Apple Pay / Google Pay / Link), shown only when at least one wallet is available (rendered uppercase via CSS).

checkout.payment.payWithApplePay.context: Accessible label of the black Apple Pay button that shows only the Apple Pay logo.

checkout.payment.payWithGooglePay.context: Accessible label of the white Google Pay button that shows only the Google Pay logo.

checkout.payment.placeOrderFailed.source: The order could not be placed. Please try again or contact support.
checkout.payment.placeOrderFailed.context: Payment step error when placing the order fails, with support escalation.

checkout.payment.priceChangedBody.source: The total changed from {previousTotal} to {newTotal}. Please review the updated order summary before completing your payment.
checkout.payment.priceChangedBody.context: Body of the amber price-change notice under the headline, telling the customer the old and new order total before they confirm payment.

placeholders.previousTotal: Formatted previous order total including currency symbol (getFormattedMoney)
placeholders.newTotal: Formatted new order total including currency symbol (getFormattedMoney)

checkout.payment.priceChangedTitle.context: Bold headline of the amber price-change notice (role=status) shown when the checkout total changed between page load and the pay attempt.

checkout.payment.processingPayment.context: Pay-button label (desktop button and mobile sticky bar) while the payment itself is being processed, before order creation starts.

checkout.payment.sameAsShipping.context: Label of the 'same as shipping' checkbox in the billing-address section, shown when a shipping address exists.

checkout.payment.securingWithStripe.source: Securing your payment with Stripe. This usually takes a few seconds.
checkout.payment.securingWithStripe.context: Progress copy while Stripe secures the payment (3DS/redirect handling).

checkout.payment.sessionExpired.source: The payment session expired after the redirect. Please try again.
checkout.payment.sessionExpired.context: Error when the payment session expired after a redirect return (e.g. 3DS).

checkout.payment.stripeConfigFailed.context: Error when paymentGatewayInitialize did not yield a usable Stripe configuration.

checkout.payment.stripeKeyMissing.source: The Stripe publishable key is missing. Check the Stripe app configuration in the Saleor Dashboard.
checkout.payment.stripeKeyMissing.context: Error when the Stripe publishable key is missing from the gateway config (admin-oriented copy shown to the customer).

checkout.payment.stripeLoadTitle.context: Alert title when the Stripe JS SDK fails to load in the payment step.

checkout.payment.stripeProcessFailed.source: The payment could not be processed. Check that the Stripe app in Saleor is active.
checkout.payment.stripeProcessFailed.context: Error when a Stripe transactionInitialize/transactionProcess returned no transaction id.

checkout.payment.stripeWebhookFailed.source: The Stripe app webhook failed. In Saleor Dashboard → Apps → Stripe, check that webhooks are being delivered successfully.
checkout.payment.stripeWebhookFailed.context: Error when a failed Stripe transaction event indicates webhook delivery failure (admin-oriented copy shown to the customer).

checkout.payment.submittingOrder.context: In-button loading text while a free (0 EUR) order is being completed.

checkout.payment.totalChanged.source: The order total has changed. Review the updated amount and try again.
checkout.payment.totalChanged.context: Error when the live order total materially changed versus the displayed amount before authorization; also used by the server-side amount-tamper guard.

checkout.payment.totalUnavailable.source: The order total is not available. Refresh the page and try again.
checkout.payment.totalUnavailable.context: Error when the checkout total is missing at the start of payment.

checkout.payment.totalsRefreshFailed.source: The order total could not be refreshed. Please try again.
checkout.payment.totalsRefreshFailed.context: Error when the pre-payment live refresh of the order total fails.

checkout.payment.unavailable.source: The payment system is unavailable. Please try again.
checkout.payment.unavailable.context: Payment step error when the payment transport/system cannot be reached.

checkout.payment.unexpectedError.source: An unexpected error occurred while completing the payment.
checkout.payment.unexpectedError.context: Generic unexpected-error fallback during payment completion.

checkout.payment.validationFailed.context: Fallback for a Stripe card/validation error that carries no message.

checkout.payment.verificationUnavailable.source: We could not verify your previous payment attempt. Refresh the page — do not pay again until the status is verified.
checkout.payment.verificationUnavailable.context: An interrupted payment attempt could not be verified against Saleor — blocks retry guidance.

checkout.shipping.deliveryEstimate.context: Delivery-time estimate under each shipping-method name, rendered only when both minimum and maximum delivery days exist (e.g. "2-5 pracovných dní").

placeholders.max: method.maximumDeliveryDays (number); also drives the plural branch

checkout.shipping.ecoBadge.context: Small green pill badge next to a shipping-method name when the method is detected as ecological (name contains eco/green).

checkout.shipping.loadingMethods.context: Shown next to a spinner while the checkout context is fetching available shipping methods.

checkout.shipping.methodSaveFailed.source: We couldn't save your shipping method. Please try again.
checkout.shipping.methodSaveFailed.context: Error shown above the shipping-method list when saving the picked shipping method fails (both the immediate-save-on-pick path and the retry-on-Continue path); the previous selection is restored.

checkout.shipping.noAddressYet.source: Please go back and enter your shipping address first.
checkout.shipping.noAddressYet.context: Amber warning box on the shipping step when no shipping methods exist because no shipping address has been entered yet.

checkout.shipping.noMethodsForCountry.source: No shipping methods are available for {countryName}. Please check your address or contact us.
checkout.shipping.noMethodsForCountry.context: Amber warning box on the shipping step when a shipping address exists but no carrier serves that country/address.

placeholders.countryName: Localized country name of the shipping address (Intl.DisplayNames via localizeCountryName, threaded with the market locale); falls back to checkout.shipping.yourAddressFallback when unresolvable. Grammar note: interpolated after Slovak preposition "Pre" (accusative).

checkout.shipping.selectMethod.context: Validation message shown when the customer clicks Continue on the shipping step without any shipping method selected; focus moves to the first radio option.

checkout.shipping.title.context: H2 section heading above the shipping-method radio list on the shipping step, always visible.

checkout.shipping.yourAddressFallback.context: Fallback fragment interpolated as {countryName} into checkout.shipping.noMethodsForCountry when the country name cannot be resolved; sk form is accusative to fit after "Pre".

checkout.steps.confirmation.context: Confirmation step label; shown as the mobile progress text when the customer reaches the order-confirmation step (filtered out of the desktop progress nav).

checkout.steps.information.context: Step 1 label in the checkout header progress nav (desktop) and mobile progress bar, shown on every checkout.

checkout.steps.navAria.context: aria-label on the desktop checkout progress <nav>; screen-reader only.

checkout.steps.payment.context: Payment step label in the checkout header progress nav / mobile progress bar.

checkout.steps.progress.context: Mobile progress line above the checkout progress bar on every step except confirmation (e.g. 'Krok 2 z 3').

placeholders.total: total number of visible checkout steps (2 or 3)

checkout.steps.shipping.context: Shipping step label in the checkout header progress nav / mobile progress bar; only when the checkout contains physical products.

checkout.summary.contact.context: Label of the customer-email row in the summary-context box on the shipping and payment steps; rendered in a narrow 64px label column.

checkout.summary.delivery.context: Label of the delivery row in the payment-step summary-context box for digital-only checkouts (no shipping); narrow 64px label column.

checkout.summary.digitalDelivery.context: Value of the delivery row in the payment-step summary-context box for digital-only checkouts.

checkout.summary.discount.context: Discount line label in the order-summary amounts list; only shown when a discount applies.

checkout.summary.hideSummary.context: Mobile collapsible order-summary toggle label while the summary is expanded.

checkout.summary.method.context: Label of the chosen-shipping-method row in the summary-context box on the payment step (physical products only); narrow 64px label column.

checkout.summary.productFallback.context: Fallback product name for an order-summary line item whose variant/product name is missing; also used as the image alt fallback.

checkout.summary.shipTo.context: Label of the shipping-address row in the summary-context box on the shipping and payment steps; narrow 64px label column.

checkout.summary.showSummary.context: Mobile collapsible order-summary toggle label while the summary is collapsed.

checkout.summary.title.context: Desktop order-summary card heading (h2), always visible on md+ screens on every checkout step and on the order confirmation.

checkout.summary.total.context: Grand-total label at the bottom of the order-summary amounts section (existing cart.total 'Celkom' wording differs, so this is a separate key).

email.orderConfirmed.subject.context: E-mail subject of the order-confirmation e-mail.

placeholders.number: order number as displayed to the customer

email.orderConfirmed.preheader.source: Thank you! We have received your order {number} and are preparing it.
email.orderConfirmed.preheader.context: Hidden preview line shown by inbox clients next to the subject.

placeholders.number: order number as displayed to the customer

email.orderConfirmed.title.context: Main headline of the order-confirmation e-mail.

email.orderConfirmed.intro.source: Thank you! We have received your order and are preparing it.

email.orderConfirmed.outro.source: We will let you know as soon as it is on its way.

placeholders.number: order number as displayed to the customer

email.order.summaryTitle.context: Uppercase heading above the product list.

email.order.taxIncluded.context: VAT-included note UNDER the total (tax is inside the price, never added on top).

email.order.shippingTo.context: Uppercase heading of the shipping address block.

email.order.billingTo.context: Uppercase heading of the billing address block.

email.order.noShippingRequired.context: Shown instead of the shipping address for non-shippable orders.

email.order.noBillingAddress.context: Shown when the order has no billing address.

email.footer.support.source: Questions? Reply to this email and we will be happy to help.
email.footer.support.context: Support line in the e-mail footer.
